product_metadata.title: Amélie Home Boho Throw Blanket, Bohemian Farmhouse Colorful Striped Blanket with Tassels Decorative Woven Textured, Soft Cozy and Lightweight for Spring Summer, Beige, 50" x 60"
features: UNIQUE DESIGN - Meet our new favorite boho throw blanket. Full of handmade details, this knit throw blanket will add a bohemian style and a perfect farmhouse look to your home. Woven geometric details and fabulous tassels are inspired by the French countryside lifestyle to decorate and your place in a natural and tasteful way.

HIGH QUALITY - Woven from high-quality knit, this decorative boho throw blanketdoes not shrink and wrinkle after washing. It's lightweight and durable as well as easy to maintain. Tufted details and fringe are well-made and won't unravel in the wash.

MULTY PURPOSE - Amélie Home textured throw blanket is handy any time of the year. It will keep you warm in the fall and winter seasons and freshen up your home with a pop of color and style during spring and summer. Keep one on your sofa, couch, or at the end of your bed for cozy nights by the fireside, or take outdoors for chilly summer evenings on the farmhouse porch or for a picnic at the park.

IDEAL GIFT - Lovely packaged with a bow ribbon, surprise your loved one, a friend, or a colleague with this amazing gift. Not only this knit throw blanket is very stylish and comfortable, but also super easy to maintain, which makes it a perfect present for a Mother's day or other occasion.

EASY CARE - Not only it looks and feels amazing, it's also very durable and easy to maintain. We recommend washing in cold water on a gentle cycle. Tumble dry on your lowest dryer setting with low heat (do not iron).
